text:
ashley_arch: quick RFC follow-up on canary escape-hatch. need a tiny translation layer so runtime can make fast fallback choices while observer provides higher-fidelity signals.

ben_platform: agree. runtime = fast decisions, observer = consolidated verdicts. keep API small.

maria_dev: product wants graded actions: cap tokens -> switch small variant -> full fallback. policy primitives must express tiers.

dave_oncall: ops needs deterministic local runway if control plane drops. prefer persisted counters and default-safe behavior.

liam_infra: storage plan: local redis AOF for budgets + periodic snapshot to etcd. on restart, replay AOF then reconcile.

ashley_arch: tiny policy sketch: {id:"roll-6323",conds:[p95>200ms for 2m],actions:[degrade(max_tokens=128),fallback(variant=stable)],budget:"500/1m",version:"v1"}. unknown fields -> safe fallback.

ben_platform: will draft gRPC verdict API (pass|degrade|fail + reason codes). router merges with capability map.

maria_dev: I'll list eval-suite signals and thresholds.

dave_oncall: add smoothing (2 consecutive windows) before global pager; local fallbacks can be immediate but logged.

ashley_arch: follow-ups assigned, 30m sync tomorrow 10:00. thanks everyone.
